# rlsbl commit

Commit the named files through safegit with the Autogenerated: true trailer, marking the commit machine-made so changelog coverage exempts it. Files are named relative to the working directory or absolutely, and must lie in the repository holding it; a named file that did not change is left out of the commit, and a commit none of whose files changed is refused, as is a file git ignores. safegit must be on PATH.

**Effect:** mutating

**Dry run:** not supported — the whole command is one safegit commit, and safegit, not rlsbl, decides what is staged, which hooks run, and whether anything changes, so a preview could only echo the arguments given

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--message` |  | str | required |  | The commit message; the Autogenerated: true trailer is added to it |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `files` | list[str] (variadic) | required | The files to commit |
